parameters.name: supply_voltage
parameters.description: Operating DC supply voltage range within which all AC and DC parameters are guaranteed by the manufacturer
parameters.notes: Candidate VCC range must fully contain base chip VCC range. Example: base is 4.75-5.5V, candidate must support at minimum 4.75-5.5V.

parameters.name: operating_temperature
parameters.description: Ambient air temperature range over which all DC and AC specifications are guaranteed
parameters.notes: Candidate temperature range must be equal to or wider than base chip temperature range.

parameters.name: input_high_voltage
parameters.description: Minimum voltage that must be applied to an input pin for the chip to recognise it as a logic HIGH level. The system must drive signals at or above this threshold.
parameters.notes: Candidate VIH(min) must be <= base VIH(min). A lower threshold means the chip recognises HIGH at a lower voltage and is more tolerant — compatible with a system designed for the base chip.

parameters.name: input_low_voltage
parameters.description: Maximum voltage at an input pin that is still recognised as a logic LOW. The system must drive signals at or below this threshold for a valid LOW.
parameters.notes: Candidate VIL(max) must be >= base VIL(max). A higher VIL(max) means the chip tolerates a higher voltage on the low rail — more tolerant, safe in a system designed for the base chip.

parameters.name: output_high_voltage
parameters.description: Minimum output pin voltage when the output is driving a logic HIGH with the specified load current drawn from the pin.
parameters.notes: Candidate VOH(min) must be >= base VOH(min). Candidate must drive HIGH at least as high as the base chip under equivalent load.

parameters.name: output_low_voltage
parameters.description: Maximum output pin voltage when the output is sinking the specified load current at logic LOW.
parameters.notes: Candidate VOL(max) must be <= base VOL(max). Candidate must pull the bus down at least as low as the base chip under equivalent load.

parameters.name: supply_current_active
parameters.description: Maximum current drawn from the VCC supply during active read or write operation with outputs switching.
parameters.notes: Candidate ICC(max) must be <= base ICC(max). Candidate must not exceed the power budget designed for the base chip.

parameters.name: read_cycle_time
parameters.description: Minimum elapsed time from the beginning of one read cycle (valid address asserted) to the beginning of the next consecutive read cycle. Reciprocal of maximum sustained read throughput frequency.
parameters.notes: Candidate tRC(min) must be <= base tRC(min). A smaller minimum cycle time means the chip is faster and works in a system timed for the base chip.

parameters.name: address_access_time
parameters.description: Maximum propagation delay from all address inputs becoming stable to valid and stable data appearing on the output bus. Assumes chip enable and output enable are already asserted. This is the headline read speed specification.
parameters.notes: Primary read speed parameter. Candidate tAA(max) must be <= base tAA(max). This is the most commonly cited speed grade number in SRAM part numbers (e.g. -70 = 70 ns).

parameters.name: chip_enable_access_time
parameters.description: Maximum propagation delay from chip enable (CE / E-bar / CS) going active LOW to valid data on the output bus, with address inputs and output enable already stable and asserted.
aliases: chip enable low to output valid
chip enable low to data valid

parameters.name: output_enable_access_time
parameters.description: Maximum propagation delay from output enable (OE / G-bar) going active LOW to valid data on the output bus, with address and chip enable already asserted. Typically shorter than tAA and tACE since internal decode is already done.
aliases: output enable low to output valid

parameters.name: chip_enable_to_output_low_z
parameters.description: Minimum time after chip enable goes active LOW before the output pins begin to transition out of high-impedance (tri-state). Output data is not yet valid but the bus is no longer floating.
aliases: chip enable low to output low-Z
chip enable low to output bus driven
parameters.notes: System relies on outputs not driving the bus for at least this duration after CE assertion. Candidate must provide equal or more quiet time before driving.

parameters.name: output_enable_to_output_low_z
parameters.description: Minimum time after output enable goes active LOW before the output pins begin to transition out of high-impedance (tri-state).
aliases: output enable low to output low-Z

parameters.name: chip_disable_to_output_high_z
parameters.description: Maximum time after chip enable goes inactive HIGH before the output pins return to high-impedance (tri-state). Critical parameter for multi-device shared bus designs — the bus cannot be driven by another device until this time has elapsed.
aliases: chip enable high to output Hi-Z
CE high to output high impedance
chip enable high to output float
parameters.notes: Candidate must release the bus within the same or shorter time. Violation causes bus contention on shared-bus systems.

parameters.name: output_disable_to_output_high_z
parameters.description: Maximum time after output enable goes inactive HIGH before the output pins return to high-impedance (tri-state).
aliases: output enable high to output Hi-Z
OE high to output high impedance
output enable high to output float

parameters.name: output_hold_after_address_change
parameters.description: Minimum time that the current valid output data is held stable after an address transition begins. After this window, output becomes indeterminate until the new address access completes.
parameters.notes: System may pipeline address changes relying on this hold window. Candidate must guarantee at least the same hold duration.

parameters.name: write_cycle_time
parameters.description: Minimum elapsed time for a complete write operation from the start of one write cycle to the start of the next. Must be met for every write operation regardless of which control signal (WE or CE) governs the cycle.
parameters.notes: Candidate tWC(min) must be <= base tWC(min). System provides this timing budget for each write.

parameters.name: address_setup_to_write_enable
parameters.description: Minimum time address inputs must be stable before write enable (WE / W-bar) falls LOW at the start of a WE-controlled write cycle.
aliases: address valid to write enable low

parameters.name: address_setup_to_chip_enable
parameters.description: Minimum time address inputs must be stable before chip enable (CE / E-bar) falls LOW at the start of a CE-controlled write cycle.
aliases: address valid to chip enable low

parameters.name: write_enable_pulse_width
parameters.description: Minimum time write enable (WE / W-bar) must remain asserted LOW for a valid write to be guaranteed. This is the core timing budget for the internal write operation.
parameters.notes: System provides a fixed WE pulse width. Candidate must complete a valid write within that same pulse — i.e. candidate tWP(min) must be <= base tWP(min).

parameters.name: chip_enable_write_pulse_width
parameters.description: Minimum time chip enable (CE / E-bar) must remain asserted LOW in a CE-controlled write cycle to guarantee the write completes.

parameters.name: address_valid_to_write_enable_high
parameters.description: Minimum time address inputs must have been stable before write enable (WE / W-bar) goes inactive HIGH at the end of a write cycle. Ensures the address is valid throughout the critical write window.
aliases: address setup to end of write
address valid before WE rising edge

parameters.name: address_valid_to_chip_enable_high
parameters.description: Minimum time address inputs must have been stable before chip enable (CE / E-bar) goes inactive HIGH at the end of a CE-controlled write cycle.
aliases: address setup to end of CE write
address valid before CE rising edge

parameters.name: write_enable_high_to_address_hold
parameters.description: Minimum time address inputs must remain stable after write enable (WE / W-bar) returns HIGH at the end of a write cycle.
aliases: write enable high to address hold

parameters.name: chip_enable_high_to_address_hold
parameters.description: Minimum time address inputs must remain stable after chip enable (CE / E-bar) returns HIGH at the end of a CE-controlled write cycle.
aliases: chip enable high to address hold

parameters.name: data_setup_to_write_enable_high
parameters.description: Minimum time data inputs (DQ pins) must be stable and valid before write enable (WE / W-bar) returns HIGH to close the write window.
aliases: data valid to write enable high
data setup before WE rising edge

parameters.name: data_setup_to_chip_enable_high
parameters.description: Minimum time data inputs (DQ pins) must be stable and valid before chip enable (CE / E-bar) returns HIGH to close a CE-controlled write cycle.
aliases: data valid to chip enable high
data setup before CE rising edge

parameters.name: data_hold_after_write_enable_high
parameters.description: Minimum time data inputs (DQ pins) must remain stable after write enable (WE / W-bar) returns HIGH at the end of the write cycle.
aliases: write enable high to input transition
data hold after WE rising edge

parameters.name: data_hold_after_chip_enable_high
parameters.description: Minimum time data inputs (DQ pins) must remain stable after chip enable (CE / E-bar) returns HIGH at the end of a CE-controlled write cycle.
aliases: chip enable high to input transition
data hold after CE rising edge

parameters.name: write_enable_low_to_output_high_z
parameters.description: Maximum time after write enable (WE / W-bar) goes active LOW before the bidirectional DQ pins transition to high-impedance. The bus must be released before the external data driver can safely drive the DQ lines with write data.
aliases: write enable low to output high impedance
parameters.notes: After WE goes low, outputs must float to avoid bus contention with data being driven onto DQ. Candidate must release the bus within the same or shorter time.

parameters.name: write_enable_high_to_output_active
parameters.description: Minimum time after write enable (WE / W-bar) returns HIGH before the DQ output pins transition out of high-impedance back into the active read-driven state.
aliases: write enable high to output active
parameters.notes: System should wait at least this long after WE de-asserts before relying on output data. Candidate must guarantee equal or more recovery time.
